question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>y</mi><mfenced><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>x</mi><mo>></mo><mn>1</mn></math>, be the solution of the differential equation <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>, with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mfenced><mn>2</mn></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>e</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac></math>. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mfenced><mn>3</mn></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>e</mi><mi>α</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>β</mi><msup><mi>e</mi><mi>α</mi></msup></mrow></mfrac></math>. then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi></math> is equal to ______.

solution.text:
Given, x-1dydx+2xy=1x-1

⇒dydx+2xx-1·y=1x-12

I.F=e∫2xx-1=e2x×x-12

Solution will be,

y×I.F=∫1x-12×I.F

Solving above with y2=1+e42e4 we get,

y=1x-12e2x+12e2x

So, y3=e6+18e6, now on comparing with y3=eα+1βeα we get, α+β=14
